definitions.gloss: latest model; newest version; current model
definitions.explanation: The most recently released version of a product, especially cars, electronics, appliances, or other manufactured goods. Emphasizes that this is the most up-to-date version available.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}モデル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The latest model has been released.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最新|さいしん}モデル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I upgraded to the latest model of smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最新|さいしん}モデル⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{燃費|ねんぴ}→燃費：18969_nenpi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}している→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: As you'd expect from the latest model, both fuel efficiency and safety have improved significantly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧ (newest, latest) and ⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧ (model). Frequently used in consumer and technology contexts when discussing product releases, upgrades, and comparisons between generations of the same product line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最新|さいしん}モデル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}える→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧: to upgrade to the latest model
- {最新|さいしん}モデル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for the latest model to appear/launch
- {最新|さいしん}モデル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: features of the latest model
- {最新|さいしん}モデル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧: to try the latest model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new model/type — often used for cars and official product designations
- ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧: new product — broader term covering any newly released product
- ⟦{最新版|さいしんばん}→最新版：16448_saishinban⟧: latest version/edition — used for software, books, and documents
